It can be used to create own ChatGPT clone and Github Copilot alternative.

[Resources]
DifyAI Github Repo:  https://github.com/langgenius/dify

[Key Takeaways]
🚀 Unlock the Power of AI: Dify is an open-source project that allows you to create custom AI workflows, apps, and chatbots without requiring coding skills, perfect for building conversational AI.

💻 Visual Workflow Builder: Dify provides a user-friendly graphical interface to interact with workflows, making it easy to create and manage complex AI applications, similar to LangChain.

🤝 Seamless Integration: Dify supports multiple LLM providers, including Ollama, allowing you to connect your workflows to various language models and APIs, ideal for RAG applications.

📈 Streamline Your Workflow: Dify enables you to create RAG (Retrieve, Ask, Generate) pipelines, making it easy to integrate your workflows with internet search and other tools, perfect for SEO optimization.

📊 Optimize Your Models: Dify's LLMOps feature allows you to check logs, fine-tune models, and perform other tasks to optimize your AI workflows, similar to Hugging Face.

🚫 No Coding Required: With Dify, you can create custom AI applications without writing a single line of code, making it an ideal solution for non-technical users, perfect for low-code development.

📈 Scalable Solutions: Dify's Backend as a Service (BaaS) feature provides a scalable solution for deploying and managing your AI applications.

📊 Customizable Workflows: Dify allows you to customize your AI workflows and apps to suit your specific needs, making it an ideal solution for businesses and individuals alike, perfect for workflow automation.

👍 Community-Driven: Dify is an open-source project, which means that it is community-driven and constantly evolving to meet the needs of its users, similar to Supabase.
